Independent review of PR #2000 at head `e2d0797e9`. The review built locally in a detached worktree. No runner job was started.

**Verdict: code is clean. No blockers.**

## What the PR changes

`State::reset_for_open` now calls `frame_all` after it swaps in the new world. A document open frames the camera on the opened part and stock. The orbit pivot is then the part, not a target an older view left behind. The PR adds two value tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/camera_target.rs` and one decision record. The diff is four files, +116 lines, no deletions.

## Checks against the code

- `reset_for_open` has two call sites: `open_project_path` and `open_project_bytes`. Both are document-open paths. Both get the framed camera.
- No save, undo or redo path calls `reset_for_open`. A mid-edit restore does not re-frame.
- `frame_all` reads only the facets of named entities and the WCS origins. The envelope draws overlay lines only (`crates/ui/src/work_envelope.rs` into `interact::collect_overlay`). The envelope cannot move the target.
- The body's cause text is true. Before this fix, an open left the old document's target, or the default target `[0, 0, 0]` (`Camera::default`, `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs:1072`). It never put the envelope centre there. The envelope box draws about the work origin, near that default, so the orbit only appeared to turn about the envelope centre. The "before" render shows the pivot at the default target, and agrees with the body text.
- `frame_all` runs after `self.world = loaded`, so it reads the new document. It keeps the projection mode. An empty document gets the default camera. A failed open does not touch the camera.
- The camera is ephemeral view state, not the command history (`actions::frame_all` says so in its comment). The added call breaks no "Everything Is a Command" rule.
- The diff adds no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests. No raw Flecs call is added. No process file is touched. The decision record uses the house format. `Changelog:` line is present.

## Mutation check

The review disabled the `frame_all` call in `reset_for_open`, in the review worktree only. `open_frames_the_part_with_the_envelope_on_and_off` then failed: the parked target `[400, 400, 400]` survived the open. The other pin stayed green, as it must: it tests the frame path, which the mutation did not touch. The review reverted the mutation and ran both pins green again. Nothing was committed.

## Findings

- Blockers: none.
- Minor (body wording, not code): the body says "#1998 (enhancement, P6, effort:medium)". Issue #1998 now carries `P?`: the maintainer holds it. One body line should say `P?`.
- Nit: `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is 4511 lines. It is far past the 400-line cap. This is a standing debt, not growth from this PR; the diff adds 3 lines.
- Nit: File > New and an import keep the old camera. The body says so. It is outside #1997. It can take its own polish issue if the maintainer wants it.

## Screenshots

The before/after renders are in the body and the image links resolve (`pr-2000/` at commit `a1eedbe28`). The reviewer looked at all four. The before pair shows the part cropped and the view swung off it after a fixed orbit. The after pair shows the part framed and centred.

The review is clean and GitHub reads the PR as MERGEABLE, so this PR gets `merge-ready`. The PR is still a draft. Flag it ready before a merge (`gh pr ready 2000`).
